basic_info.description: This centrally located 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo boasts an open-concept layout, blending comfortable living with an active neighborhood vibe. Large double-pane windows with elegant shutters invite an abundance of natural light from multiple directions into this corner unit building.  Walking right in you are greeted with a grand chef's kitchen featuring a sleek quartz center island, built-in Viking microwave, Miele refrigerator, stainless steel Viking range and other staineless applia. Each spa-inspired bathroom is a true retreat, complete with heated tile floors, LED frameless mirrors, concealed tank Toto toilets with bidets, floating vanities, and beautifully tiled showers with frameless glass doors.    Hallway has in-unit washer/dryer, generous closet and storage space. Ammenities include deeded parking and direct access to a shared outdoor garden.    Directly across the street, you'll find the vibrant NOPA park, which offers basketball courts, a playground, and dog-friendly spaces. The neighborhood boasts a Walk Score of 94 and a Bike Score of 97, making it incredibly convenient for pedestrians, cyclists, and commuters alike. Enjoy having Golden Gate Park right down the street. Come take look!
